description: This file implements the SystemInfo class within the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace, providing system information management, including network, security, location, device ID, time, and software version details. It manages notifications, device identifiers, and system state updates.

classes.name: SystemInfo
classes.description: Main class providing system information and notification management within the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Internet
classes.description: Represents network-related information such as IP address and network type.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Security
classes.description: Provides security-related information, such as callsign.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Location
classes.description: Contains location details like timezone, country, region, city, latitude, and longitude.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Id
classes.description: Represents device identification details including identifier, architecture, chipset, and firmware version.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Register
methods.description: Registers a notification client for system updates.

methods.name: SystemInfo::RawDeviceId
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of a network interface.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Update
methods.description: Triggers an update of system information and notifies clients.

methods.name: SystemInfo::RecursiveList
methods.description: Recursively notifies registered clients of updates.
